provenance.note: Invented values. Some cases combine alternative mapper branches for display coverage; no claim these coexist on a real account. No credentials, real account data, network probes.

notes: Fable is source-supported temporary promo, not a timeless guarantee. Usage credits uses major currency used, cap nullable; unlimited cap has no percent/meter.
Prepaid Balance has no denominator; do not infer a meter from monthly spend.
Primary/secondary classify by actual duration. This spans variants; no claim one account has four canonical windows. Preserve limitId/additional. Reset coupons independent of quota.
API/web Go has used/limit null; local estimates have raw USD costs but no currency marker. Each window source=web/local; balanceUsd legacy alias is USD. Go API preferred over web/local.

Requests / model pools / Overall are alternative branches, combined for display coverage. Team pool has USD raw costs without currency marker. On-demand may have nullable cap and always showMeter=false.
Included usage becomes billing only when explicit monthly. Unified omits separate Grok/on-demand. Prepaid is positive USD amount with no meter.
Dynamic group names normalize Gemini / Claude/GPT; unknown groups retain name. Disabled/null fraction is not zero. Legacy pools use weekly kind with dynamic model name and null duration.
Legacy snapshot.pools preserve dynamic name and lack known duration.
Credits points and USD spend are different units. Credit upstream scaled /1e6; paid spend /1e8. Missing plan percentage omits window; planless credit-only valid.
Core is an additional pool. extraUsageBalanceCents /100 USD; core synthesizes Balance credits window when balance supplied.
Legacy token units; reliable used/allowance optional, no currency.
Top-level usage label can be dynamic. Monthly shared total; Code subset only detail, raw composition may exceed clamped meter 100%. Raw counters reduced to percentages.
Alternative periods all retain billing kind; label reflects actual period. Only usedPercent crosses mapper, raw money does not.
Used% clamped by core; overage survives resetDescription. Raw entitlement/counts not projected.
Unlimited not an explicit shared property: only absent reset / percentage. Do not invent unlimited marker from raw upstream metadata that does not cross mapper.
Token Spend is money even without metric=spend. Predictions are counts. Source-specific limitId determines units.
Explicit null input limit means unlimited; missing limit property omits window.
Rolling costs are USD but currency absent; upstream only shows rolling percentages. Trusted monthly allowance corroborated by rolling caps. Top-up never expires. Monthly percentLeads=true upstream.
Null limit means unknown denominator; amount remains valid.
Plan and wallet coexist. gift/cash split, observed spend/tracking and plan fallback fields matter. Currency read from upstream, not inferred.
Separate product row with same provider; intentionally no weekly duration. renewalMode is billing cadence, not quota.
Expired plan not active quota; balance.planStatus persists independently of windows.
MCP source minute marker is misleading and discarded. Cash CN=CNY/global=USD; observed cumulative-spend deltas qualified by trackingSince.
Daily/one-time pools aggregate by model. Earliest timestamp can replenish, expire or both; preserve boundaryKind, dynamic label and limitId.
Uses parseZaiUsage, fixed bigmodel-cn. No team cash or ZCode collection.
Credits and Bonus are counts. Overage used=extra credits; remaining=estimated USD COST, not remaining balance. No metric/currency, provider-specific semantics required.
Resources expire separately; aggregate has no common reset. Partial malformed active aggregate rejected.
limitNum=-1 means unlimited; limit/remaining null with meaningful used.
total/shared quotas summed. Parser unit is not copied to window; raw count units documented by upstream windowText.
Single funded currency selected; no native rate windows. Spend derives sampled paid-balance changes; trackingSince/monthSinceTracking qualify partial periods.
Daily/weekly can independently hide/absent; overage balance valid standalone. Cents normalized USD.
Only general model bucket. Source remaining percentages inverted. status=3 placeholder suppressed. API/legacy endpoint same normalized windows.
Explicit API mode uses available_amount; CN=CNY/EN=USD. Missing value not zero.
Grant expiry not billing reset. monthSpend estimated from rates; tranches and usageSummary private, earliest window expiry publicly retained.
Key periods alternatives. Daily kind=session per source. USD amounts omit window currency; balance supplies USD. BYOK accounting flag reduced upstream.
Percent is used percentage; plan/update projected separately.
Headers have request counts, duration absent.
Label Requests but used=usage.total_tokens. Shared schema no unit discriminator; do not invent percentage or unit from label.
session may be hourly 60 OR session 300; duration disambiguates. Empty wire labels.
Active pack aggregate has no common reset. Raw used overage retained even if percent clamps. Malformed active pack rejects aggregate.
Optional quota config gives limit only; percent remains meaningful with null denominator. Monthly-only plan valid.
Blank label defaults Monthly. ok windows=[] valid with no active subscription.
Both fractions/resets required; invalid yields unavailable.
Buckets reduced to percentage; no metric=credits, raw amounts or currency. Optional reset permits 30d duration; absent reset leaves duration absent.
basic_ai_credits per_user counts. Rolling SIX hours; no metric/currency. Missing reset unknown.
NewAPI units normalized USD. Token expiry carried in balance.expiresAt, not window reset; group private.
Unlimited amount=null differs zero; historical spend still meaningful.
Monthly private usageSummary has caches, cost, actual cost, latency.
Custom paths/divisor normalize USD; missing used/total stay null. Zero valid exhausted balance. Raw credential/URL/path config excluded.
Token adapter owns a separate key quota; expiry carried in balance metadata.
Action-required empty windows are not a zero quota or healthy empty account.
